::: {.block title="Data"}
Chl *a* profiles from BGC-Argo floats and OOI moorings (@fig-data; March 2024 – October 2026), estimated from in situ fluorescence, were averaged into 10 m bins to 200 m. The satellite data were remote-sensing reflectance ($R_{rs}$): PACE OCI L3 daily 4 km (172 bands) and OLCI L3 daily (11 bands). After quality control, 9,542 Argo profiles (831 floats, global distribution) and 20,971 OOI 3 h windows (30 instruments, 5 locations) had PACE matchups; more had OLCI.
:::
